category: Application Library examples: Granular Flow Module
description: Ready-made, documented example simulations installed with the Granular Flow Module. Each lists its physics interfaces, couplings and study steps; solve one with comsol_run_example or adapt its Java build script.

tools.name: Angle of Repose [Granular Flow Module example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the Granular Flow Module (Flow and Material Characterization): Angle of Repose. Physics interfaces: Granular Flow (gran). Study steps: Time Dependent. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.
tools.usage: MCP: comsol_run_example("Granular_Flow_Module/Flow_and_Material_Characterization/angle_of_repose") to solve it, comsol_example_info("angle_of_repose", include_java=true) for its build script. COMSOL: File > Application Libraries > Granular Flow Module > Flow and Material Characterization > angle of repose

parameters.name: gran
parameters.description: physics interface Granular Flow (API type GranularFlow)
